Product overview

F4 is a compact mini electric bike with rear-wheel hub drive, a 48V 15Ah ternary-lithium battery, front and rear disc brakes, and a 25Kg kerb weight.

Rear-wheel hub drive2500W maximum power with a compact drive layout.
Lightweight platform25Kg kerb weight with a 100Kg maximum load.
48V battery system15Ah ternary-lithium battery and 4H charging time.
Disc-brake controlFront and rear disc brakes with a 2000-pound rear shock.

核心亮点

2500W hub motor

Rear-wheel hub drive packages the official 2500W maximum power in a compact layout.

50Km endurance

Official endurance is 50Km when travelling at no more than 25Km/h.

25Kg kerb weight

The official 25Kg kerb weight is paired with a maximum load of 100Kg.

2000-pound rear shock

A 2000-pound rear shock works with the official 90mm-travel front fork.
